title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Premium Revision Paper #13

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the seed activity, why do we plant two tins? (1 mark)
   A. To make it look neat
   B. To use up all the soil
   C. To compare seeds with water and seeds without water
   D. Because one tin is too small

2. Which Sanskrit word means water? (1 mark)
   A. Jal
   B. Vayu
   C. Agni
   D. Prithvi

3. Where did Prince Siddhartha sit under the Bodhi tree? (1 mark)
   A. Bodh Gaya
   B. Amritsar
   C. Lumbini
   D. Nairobi

4. In which city was Guru Ram Das Ji born? (1 mark)
   A. Varanasi
   B. Lumbini
   C. Nairobi
   D. Lahore

5. If a classmate is being bullied, which teaching helps? (1 mark)
   A. Stand up for the child who is troubled
   B. Laugh
   C. Ignore it
   D. Join the bullies

6. What does the word Guru mean? (1 mark)
   A. A festival
   B. A soldier
   C. A teacher who leads from darkness to light
   D. A river

7. How would you practise Ahimsa at school? (1 mark)
   A. By teasing the smaller children
   B. By hurting insects
   C. By not bullying and by caring for animals
   D. By breaking things

8. What does Bal Kaand tell about? (1 mark)
   A. The end of the story
   B. The fourteen years in the forest
   C. The war with the demons
   D. The childhood of Ram and his brothers

9. According to the Dhammapada teachings in the lesson, hatred is ended by what? (1 mark)
   A. Love
   B. Silence
   C. Fighting
   D. More hatred

10. Who first compiled Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji? (1 mark)
   A. Guru Ram Das Ji
   B. Guru Arjan Dev Ji
   C. Valmiki
   D. Mahavir

11. Who went into the forest with Ram? (1 mark)
   A. Sita and Lakshman
   B. Bharat and Shatrughna
   C. Vishwamitra
   D. Kaikeyi

12. Who gave the Sigalovada Sutta talk? (1 mark)
   A. Valmiki
   B. Guru Arjan Dev
   C. Mahavir
   D. The Buddha

13. Who wrote the Ramayan in Sanskrit? (1 mark)
   A. Sigala
   B. Guru Arjan Dev
   C. Sage Valmiki
   D. Guru Nanak

14. What is the shikhara? (1 mark)
   A. The bell
   B. The kitchen
   C. The floor
   D. The spire above the inner room

15. How should you dress to visit a Mandir? (1 mark)
   A. Wearing school uniform
   B. Very informally
   C. Modestly
   D. Wearing a heavy coat

16. Which is a benefit of praying every day? (1 mark)
   A. It stops all rain
   B. It makes homework disappear
   C. It makes us taller
   D. It teaches discipline

17. Amina pays Ksh 200 for sugar costing Ksh 150 and is given Ksh 100 change. How much extra did she get? (1 mark)
   A. Ksh 200
   B. Ksh 100
   C. Ksh 150
   D. Ksh 50

18. How do you show integrity in a test? (1 mark)
   A. Whisper answers
   B. Look in your bag
   C. Do your own work
   D. Copy from a neighbour

19. Which faith's story in the lesson is about honest earnings? (1 mark)
   A. Buddhism
   B. Jainism
   C. Sikhism
   D. Hinduism

20. Who should you give up your seat to? (1 mark)
   A. An elderly person or a pregnant woman
   B. The loudest passenger
   C. A friend
   D. Nobody

21. When getting off a vehicle, what should you do first? (1 mark)
   A. Wait for it to stop
   B. Stand and push
   C. Jump
   D. Run

22. What should you do if you see something online that makes you uncomfortable? (1 mark)
   A. Tell a trusted adult
   B. Keep clicking
   C. Share it with friends
   D. Put it back where you found it

23. Which king is known for always telling the truth in a Hindu story? (1 mark)
   A. Harishchandra
   B. Kansa
   C. Ravan
   D. Hiranyakashipu

24. In Bhastrika, how is the breath done? (1 mark)
   A. Only in
   B. Not at all
   C. Only out
   D. In and out with equal strength

25. How does the breath in happen in Kapaal Bhaati? (1 mark)
   A. By force
   B. By hand
   C. By itself
   D. By humming

26. Where should the hands be in Vajra Asana? (1 mark)
   A. In the air
   B. On the thighs
   C. Behind the head
   D. On the floor in front

27. What does Kapaal Bhaati mean? (1 mark)
   A. Diamond pose
   B. Moon pose
   C. Sitting pose
   D. Shining forehead

28. Because God sees all we do, what should we do? (1 mark)
   A. Cheat
   B. Be honest even when alone
   C. Hide
   D. Complain

29. How should we treat others who hold different beliefs about death? (1 mark)
   A. Laugh
   B. Listen with respect
   C. Argue
   D. Ignore them

30. Which is a common mistake? (1 mark)
   A. Being honest
   B. Praying
   C. Being kind to animals
   D. Thinking Dharma is only for grown-ups

31. Why is prayer a principle of Dharma? (1 mark)
   A. It makes us thankful, calm and humble
   B. It builds houses
   C. It makes us proud
   D. It ends homework

32. Which of these is a good way to pray? (1 mark)
   A. Sit and laugh
   B. Say thank you and ask for wisdom and kindness
   C. Ask only for gifts
   D. Shout

33. Which of the five principles is about goals? (1 mark)
   A. Paramatma
   B. Punarjanam
   C. Prarthana
   D. Purushartha

34. How should you behave when visiting a friend's festival? (1 mark)
   A. Laugh at customs
   B. Listen and ask polite questions
   C. Shout
   D. Refuse to take part

35. Which of these is NOT true about the flag? (1 mark)
   A. It should be respected
   B. It may touch the ground
   C. It is a national symbol
   D. It is raised at ceremonies

36. What is patriotism? (1 mark)
   A. Fear of others
   B. Love for one's country
   C. Love for sweets
   D. Dislike of others

37. Which is a safety rule for festivals? (1 mark)
   A. Ask an adult to light lamps
   B. Play with fire
   C. Eat from the ground
   D. Run in the temple

38. What does the Moon do in modern science? (1 mark)
   A. It is a star
   B. It goes around the Earth
   C. It is a planet
   D. It goes around Mars

39. Which is a mistake? (1 mark)
   A. Making a song
   B. Using a chart
   C. Mixing up Guruvaar and Shukravaar
   D. Learning the table

40. Mangal is the Indian name for which planet? (1 mark)
   A. Jupiter
   B. Mars
   C. Venus
   D. Mercury

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Explain the words Micchami Dukkadam said at Paryushan. (2 marks)

42. Why should we visit a friend's festival respectfully? (3 marks)

43. Describe how a child can follow all five principles in one day. (5 marks)

44. State two reasons why trees and plants are important. (2 marks)

45. Give two of Parshvanath's four rules. (2 marks)

46. Explain why forgiveness is important, using Paryushan Parva. (4 marks)

47. Who was Sri Guru Ram Das Ji's teacher and predecessor? (2 marks)

48. Match four scriptures with their faiths. (4 marks)

49. Describe the day of prayers for a child. (5 marks)

50. Name the four Purusharthas. (2 marks)

51. State four ways of caring for plants and water. (4 marks)

52. Explain the meaning of Ahimsa and give two ways to practise it. (3 marks)

53. Which festival in the lesson is a national holiday and why? (2 marks)

54. Describe how to sit in Vajra Asana. (3 marks)

55. What is Dharma? (2 marks)

56. State three reasons why the Saraswati Vandana is said by students. (3 marks)

57. Choose one teaching from an Enlightened Being and say how you can follow it at school. (3 marks)

58. A shopper gives you Ksh 500 and you buy items for Ksh 320. Work out the change and say what to do if you are given Ksh 200 by mistake. (4 marks)

59. Explain how the story of Prahlad shows faith in Paramatma. (3 marks)

60. What is a Tirthankar? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — To compare seeds with water and seeds without water
   Comparing shows that water is needed for growth.

2. A — Jal
   Jal (also Apas) means water.

3. A — Bodh Gaya
   He became the Buddha at Bodh Gaya.

4. D — Lahore
   He was born in Lahore.

5. A — Stand up for the child who is troubled
   Enlightened beings teach kindness and protecting others.

6. C — A teacher who leads from darkness to light
   A guru is a teacher and guide.

7. C — By not bullying and by caring for animals
   Ahimsa means not harming others.

8. D — The childhood of Ram and his brothers
   Bal means child.

9. A — Love
   Hatred is not ended by hatred but by love.

10. B — Guru Arjan Dev Ji
   Guru Arjan Dev Ji was the fifth Guru.

11. A — Sita and Lakshman
   Sita and Lakshman chose to go with him.

12. D — The Buddha
   The Buddha spoke to a young man named Sigala.

13. C — Sage Valmiki
   Valmiki is honoured as its author.

14. D — The spire above the inner room
   It is the spire or dome.

15. C — Modestly
   Modest dress shows respect.

16. D — It teaches discipline
   Doing it regularly teaches discipline.

17. D — Ksh 50
   Correct change is 50, so 100 minus 50 is 50 extra.

18. C — Do your own work
   Doing your own work is honest.

19. C — Sikhism
   Guru Nanak and Bhai Lalo.

20. A — An elderly person or a pregnant woman
   Helping those who need seats shows kindness.

21. A — Wait for it to stop
   Wait until it has stopped.

22. A — Tell a trusted adult
   A trusted adult can help.

23. A — Harishchandra
   Harishchandra kept his word.

24. D — In and out with equal strength
   Breathing is equal, like a bellows.

25. C — By itself
   It happens on its own.

26. B — On the thighs
   Palms on the thighs.

27. D — Shining forehead
   Kapaal is forehead and bhaati is shining.

28. B — Be honest even when alone
   Honesty at all times.

29. B — Listen with respect
   Respect for others is a value.

30. D — Thinking Dharma is only for grown-ups
   Children can practise Dharma too.

31. A — It makes us thankful, calm and humble
   Prayer helps us feel calm.

32. B — Say thank you and ask for wisdom and kindness
   Ask for wisdom, not only gifts.

33. D — Purushartha
   Goals of life.

34. B — Listen and ask polite questions
   Respect is key.

35. B — It may touch the ground
   The flag should never touch the ground.

36. B — Love for one's country
   Patriotism is love for our country.

37. A — Ask an adult to light lamps
   Adults should handle flames.

38. B — It goes around the Earth
   The Moon is Earth's natural satellite.

39. C — Mixing up Guruvaar and Shukravaar
   Guruvaar is Jupiter and Shukravaar is Venus.

40. B — Mars
   Mangal is Mars, the red planet.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: May any harm I did in thought, word or deed be forgiven.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for forgiveness.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: We listen, ask polite questions, do not laugh at customs, and build peace among communities.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each point.

43. (5 marks)
   Answer: Morning prayer and Namaste (Prarthana, Paramatma), honest schoolwork (Dharma, Artha), helping a friend (Prani Daya), thinking about the day's good deeds (Punarjanam and karma).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each principle applied, up to 5.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: They give oxygen, shade, food and medicine; their leaves are used in worship (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Ahimsa, Satya, Asteya or Aparigraha (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct rule.

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: Forgiveness removes anger, mends friendships and brings peace. On the last day Jains ask everyone for forgiveness with Micchami Dukkadam.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four points.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: Guru Amar Das Ji, the third Guru.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the name and 1 mark for third Guru.

48. (4 marks)
   Answer: Ramayan: Hinduism. Kalpasutra: Jainism. Dhammapada: Buddhism. Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji: Sikhism.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each pair.

49. (5 marks)
   Answer: In the morning, the Gayatri Mantra and the Saraswati Vandana before study; at midday before meals, Twameva Mata cha Pita Twameva; in the evening, thanks to God. Also sit calmly and fold hands.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each part of the day, 1 mark for manners.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: Dharma, Artha, Kama, Moksha.
   Working / marking points: Half a mark for each.

51. (4 marks)
   Answer: Plant a tree or Tulsi, water plants early or late in the day, collect rainwater, close taps and mend leaks, and never throw plastic into rivers (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct way.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ahimsa is not harming any living being by thought, word or action. We practise it by not bullying and by caring for animals and plants.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for each example.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: Madaraka Day, because it marks a step in Kenya's history and all Kenyans celebrate it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: Kneel with knees together, bring big toes close, sit back on your heels, keep the back and head straight and place palms on the thighs.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for three correct steps.

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: The right way of living, including duty, honesty and kindness.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for two ideas.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: To ask for a clear mind, good speech and love for reading, music and the arts (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: Any sensible answer, for example Ahimsa: I will not bully or hurt classmates, and I will care for plants.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the being, 1 mark for the teaching, 1 mark for a clear action.

58. (4 marks)
   Answer: Change is 500 minus 320 = Ksh 180. If given Ksh 200, that is Ksh 20 too much, so return the Ksh 20 to the shopkeeper.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for 500 minus 320, 1 mark for 180, 1 mark for the extra 20, 1 mark for returning it.

59. (3 marks)
   Answer: Prahlad believed God is everywhere, kept praying when his father was angry, and was protected.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: A Jain teacher who shows people the path to freedom, like a guide across a river.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for teacher, 1 mark for showing the path.
